Feature.Description: SiLA 2 feature for controlling the BioTek EL406 combination washer/dispenser. Wraps the pylabrobot v1b1 EL406 driver and exposes the manifold (wash), syringe-pump, peristaltic-pump, and shaker subsystems plus the low-level driver commands (reset, abort, pause, resume, home motors, set washer manifold, queries).

Command.Description: Open the FTDI USB connection to the EL406, perform the communication test, and (unless SkipReset is true) issue a full instrument reset. In simulation mode this only flips internal state — no hardware is touched.

Parameter.Description: Optional FTDI device id / serial number. Leave empty to auto-detect the first BioTek EL406 on the USB bus.
If true, skip the post-connect full instrument reset. Use false in production; true is helpful when iterating.

Response.Description: Human readable instrument name ("BioTek EL406" or "Simulated EL406").
Product serial number returned by the device. Empty string in simulation mode.

Command.Description: Close the FTDI USB connection. Safe to call when not connected.

Assign a plate to the EL406's plate holder. The plate type (well count) is encoded into every step command on the wire, so you must call this before running any aspirate/dispense/wash/prime/shake/syringe/peristaltic command.

Parameter.Description: Total wells. Allowed: 96 or 384.

Response.Description: Name of the assigned plate resource.

Command.Description: Remove the currently assigned plate from the device's plate holder.
Send the firmware reset command (0x70). Returns when the device reports completion. Can take up to 2 minutes on real hardware.
Abort a running step. If StepType is "Current", aborts the current operation; otherwise aborts the named step type.

Parameter.Description: One of: Current, PDispense, PPrime, PPurge, SDispense, SPrime, MWash, MAspirate, MDispense, MPrime, MAutoClean, ShakeSoak.

Command.Description: Pause the currently running operation.
Resume a paused operation.
Home or verify motors. HomeType selects what to do; Motor is only used with HomeMotor / VerifyMotor types.

Parameter.Description: One of: InitAllMotors, InitPeriPump, HomeMotor, HomeXyzMotors, VerifyMotor, VerifyXyzMotors.

Motor name (ignored for the "all" home types). One of: CarrierX, CarrierY, DispHeadZ, WashHeadZ, SyringeA, SyringeB, PeriPumpPrimary, PeriPumpSecondary, LevelSenseY, WashSyringe, WashAspHeadZ, SingleWellY. Use empty string for default.

Command.Description: Tell the firmware which washer manifold is physically installed.

Parameter.Description: One of: Tube96Dual, Tube192, Tube128, Tube96Single, DeepPin96, NotInstalled.

Command.Description: Run the firmware diagnostic self-check (0x95). Returns success/error code/message.

Response.Description: True if the device reports error_code == 0.

Command.Description: Query the product serial number from the firmware.
Query the full hardware configuration: washer manifold, syringe manifold, syringe box info, and peristaltic pump installation status. Returns a JSON blob.

Response.Description: JSON object with fields: washer_manifold, syringe_manifold, syringe_box (type, size, installed), peristaltic_pump_1, peristaltic_pump_2.

Command.Description: Aspirate from all wells through the wash manifold. Two modes: Normal (uses TravelRate + Delay) and VacuumFiltration (uses VacuumTime; TravelRate is ignored).

Parameter.Description: If true, vacuum filtration mode; otherwise normal aspirate.
Head travel rate. Plate-format: "1".."5"; cell-wash: "1 CW".."4 CW", "6 CW". Default "3".
Post-aspirate delay in seconds (0-5). Normal mode only. Wire resolution: 1 ms.
Vacuum filtration time in seconds (5-999). Vacuum mode only.
X offset in steps (-60 to 60).
Y offset in steps (-40 to 40).
Z offset in 0.1 mm units (1-210). Use 0 for plate-type default.

Command.Description: Dispense to all wells through the wash manifold.

Parameter.Description: Per-well volume in uL (25-3000).
Buffer valve: A, B, C, or D.
Dispense flow rate (1-11). 1-2 = cell wash, requires VacuumDelayVolume > 0.
X offset in steps (-60 to 60).
Y offset in steps (-40 to 40).
Z offset in 0.1 mm units (1-210). Use 0 for plate-type default.
Pre-dispense volume per tube in uL. 0 disables; otherwise 25-3000.
Pre-dispense flow rate (3-11).
Vacuum delay volume in uL/well (0 disables, otherwise 0-3000).

Command.Description: Run a multi-cycle manifold wash (dispense-aspirate cycles) with optional shake/soak. Wraps the 102-byte composite MANIFOLD_WASH (0xA4) command. Exposes the most common knobs; advanced offset / secondary-aspirate / bottom-wash / sector settings stay at pylabrobot defaults.

Parameter.Description: Number of wash cycles (1-250).
Per-cycle dispense volume in uL. Use 0 for plate-type default (300 for 96-well, 100 for 384-well).
Buffer valve: A, B, C, or D.
Dispense flow rate (1-9).
Aspirate travel rate (1-9).
Soak duration in seconds (0-3599). 0 disables.
Shake duration in seconds (0-3599). 0 disables shake within the wash.
Shake intensity: Variable, Slow, Medium, or Fast.
Whether to do a final aspirate after the last cycle.

Command.Description: Prime the wash manifold fluid lines. Volume is in uL; wire resolution is 1000 uL.

Parameter.Description: Prime volume in uL (5000-999000).
Buffer valve: A, B, C, or D.
Prime flow rate (3-11).
Low-flow-path volume in uL. 0 disables; otherwise 5000-999000.
Submerge duration in seconds (0 disables, otherwise 60-86340, multiple of 60).

Command.Description: Run an auto-clean cycle. Duration on the wire is in minutes (multiple of 60 seconds).

Parameter.Description: Buffer valve: A, B, C, or D.
Cleaning duration in seconds (60-14340, multiple of 60).

Command.Description: Dispense a uniform volume to all columns of the assigned plate from a syringe pump.

Parameter.Description: Per-well volume in uL (positive).
Syringe selection: A, B, or Both.
Flow rate (1-5).
X offset in mm.
Y offset in mm.
Z offset in mm (default 33.6 for 96-well).
Post-dispense delay in seconds (0-5).
Enable pre-dispense mode.
Pre-dispense volume per tube in uL (only used when PreDispense is true).
Number of pre-dispenses (default 2).

Command.Description: Prime a syringe pump by performing aspirate-dispense refills.

Parameter.Description: Prime volume per refill in uL (80-9999).
Syringe to prime: A or B.
Flow rate (1-5).
Number of refill cycles (1-255).
Delay between cycles in seconds (0-5).
Submerge tips in fluid after priming.
Submerge duration in seconds (0 disables, otherwise multiple of 60, max 86340).

Command.Description: Dispense a uniform volume to all columns of the assigned plate from the primary peristaltic pump.

Parameter.Description: Per-well volume in uL.
Flow rate: Low, Medium, or High.
Cassette type: Any, 1uL, 5uL, or 10uL.
X offset in mm (-12.5 to 12.5).
Y offset in mm (-4.0 to 4.0).
Z offset in mm (0.1-150). Use 0 for plate default.
Pre-dispense volume in uL. 0 to disable.
Number of pre-dispenses (default 2).

Command.Description: Prime the peristaltic pump fluid lines. Specify either Volume (1-3000 uL) or Duration (1-300 s), not both. Set the unused one to 0.

Parameter.Description: Prime volume in uL (1-3000). Set to 0 to use Duration instead.
Prime duration in seconds (1-300). Set to 0 to use Volume instead.
Flow rate: Low, Medium, or High.
Cassette type: Any, 1uL, 5uL, or 10uL.

Command.Description: Purge the peristaltic pump fluid lines. Specify either Volume (1-3000 uL) or Duration (1-300 s), not both.

Parameter.Description: Purge volume in uL (1-3000). Set to 0 to use Duration instead.
Purge duration in seconds (1-300). Set to 0 to use Volume instead.
Flow rate: Low, Medium, or High.
Cassette type: Any, 1uL, 5uL, or 10uL.

Command.Description: Shake the plate with optional soak period. At least one of Duration or SoakDuration must be greater than 0.

Parameter.Description: Shake duration in seconds (0-3599). 0 disables shake.
Shake intensity: Variable, Slow (3.5 Hz), Medium (5 Hz), or Fast (8 Hz).
Soak duration in seconds (0-3599). 0 disables soak.
Move the carrier to the home position before shaking (recommended for runs over 60 s to prevent manifold drip contamination).

Property.Description: Whether the instrument is connected (FTDI USB open + comm test passed).
Cached product serial number (populated after Connect or RequestSerialNumber).
Name of the currently assigned plate, or empty string if none.
Current device status as a JSON string with all state fields (for SSE streaming to WebUI).
Icon for the device, displayed in clients and dashboards.
Rich text description of the device, used as system prompt context for LLM/MCP integrations.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Failed to open the FTDI USB connection or run the post-open communication test.
The command requires an open connection, but the instrument is not connected.
The command needs a plate (so the driver can encode plate-type on the wire) but none is assigned. Call AssignPlate first.
Failure communicating with the EL406 (USB write/read failure, NAK, timeout waiting for ACK or response frame).
The device reported an error (non-zero validity in a status poll) during the step.
One of the supplied parameters failed pylabrobot's range/format validation.
